clips.title: The story
paras: Ashenvale Outrunners is a Horde patrol-interception mission issued by Kuray'bin in Ashenvale. Night elf scouts have fanned out from Silverwing Outpost to gather intelligence on nearby Horde encampments, prompting a preemptive strike to keep the outpost's defenses hidden. By hunting down these stealthy scouts, the Horde blinds the local Alliance forces and discourages future incursions.

The forests of Ashenvale remain a contested frontier where every path and ridge is fiercely watched. Intelligence is as deadly as an axe, and reports reaching Kuray'bin confirm that night elf scouts known as Ashenvale Outrunners have slipped out from the Alliance stronghold at Silverwing Outpost. Operating in the dense wilderness east of their base and south of local Horde holdings, these scouts stalk the woodland paths to map out fortifications and track troop movements.

To prevent an organized assault, the Horde relies on eliminating enemy reconnaissance before it can return home. By hunting down the outrunners, Horde champions deny the commanders at Silverwing Outpost vital knowledge about troop strength and outpost perimeter defenses. Stripped of their forward eyes, the night elves are left disoriented and far less willing to risk aggressive maneuvers through the contested woodlands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We received reports that Ashenvale outrunners left Silverwing Outpost not long ago, and now sneak near our territories in the forest. We don't want them gathering intelligence on our defenses!
Sneak through the forests south of our post here and east of the Alliance outpost of Silverwing. Find and slay the outrunners, then return to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I await reports of your outrunner kills, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very good, friend. Your hunting skills are impressive...
The loss of those outrunners helps blind the Alliance, and when they lack intelligence they are less likely to launch attacks.
